key_insight: Simultaneous neural topology optimization jointly optimizes neural representations of state, adjoint, and design fields to produce scalable, stress-constrained designs with sharp boundaries.
engineering_relevance: The framework targets large-scale lightweight structural design where local stress limits make conventional topology optimization computationally demanding.
method: Jointly optimize custom neural networks in one loop using continuous adjoint analysis and automatic differentiation.
Combine the design objective, aggregated local stress constraints, and potential energy functionals in a multi-component loss.
Distribute domain partitions across GPUs and accumulate gradients from sequential slices to limit peak memory while preserving field continuity.
evidence_signal: On 2D benchmarks, SNTO produced sharper boundaries, smaller gray areas, and lower volume fractions than a conventional FEM-based approach; 3D demonstrations reached eight million collocation points on up to eight GPUs.
watch_item: Aggregated stress constraints warrant checking local peak stresses independently, particularly near sharp boundaries.
paper_title: Scalable Stress-Constrained Topology Optimization: A Super-resolution and Simultaneous Approach Based on Machine Learning
